name: voice-enhancer
description: Record or drop a voice file and get a clean, professional voiceover. Same sound every time.
author: Sharifur Rahman

scripts.install-app: npm run build && rm -rf "/Applications/Voice Enhancer.app" && cp -R "dist/mac-arm64/Voice Enhancer.app" /Applications/ && echo 'Installed to /Applications/Voice Enhancer.app'

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Voice Enhancer records your voice so it can clean it up into professional audio.
